extracted.name: Fresh Apple Salsa
extracted.description: This fresh apple salsa recipe features chile peppers, lime juice, cilantro, toasted walnuts, and ginger, and comes together in minutes for a tasty app.
ingredient_lines: 1 fresh Anaheim chile, seeded and sliced
1 fresh jalapeno pepper, seeded and sliced
2 tablespoons fresh ginger, peeled and thinly sliced
instruction_lines: Toss apples with lime juice in a large bowl until well coated; stir in onion, walnuts, Anaheim, jalapeño, cilantro, ginger, and salt until thoroughly combined.
